final: {"prompt": "A square, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting in oil and cold wax that fills the entire canvas edge to edge, with no frame, border, wall, room or gallery setting. The mood is a mind holding steady under pressure: patient, careful and quietly stubborn, with a tight, bright nervousness running through it. The ground is deep ultramarine and blackened indigo, scraped thin in places so a chalky bone-white underlayer shows through like held breath. Across the left two thirds, long dragged palette-knife strokes lie in dense, slightly misaligned layers of cool grey-green, slate and pale lavender. They move at a steady diagonal rhythm and are built up and corrected many times, so the edges show ghosted corrections and half-erased earlier decisions. Against this order, the upper right holds a knot of fast, short, agitated brushwork in hot vermilion, burnt orange and one strained streak of acid cadmium yellow. The strokes are thick, ridged and crusted, and they pull against each other and almost collide. A narrow torn gap of near-empty pale wash separates the two zones. It is the quietest part of the picture and holds the most tension. In the lower right, a single wide, slow sweep of deep cobalt cuts diagonally through the agitation without resolving it. A few thin, translucent glazes of warm rose drift over the cold areas like a faint, uncertain warmth. Contrast is high at the points of conflict and soft and breathing elsewhere. The texture varies from smooth, glassy veils to coarse impasto, with visible bristle marks, drips running in one direction, and dry-brush skips. Large areas of empty space are left unresolved on purpose. The composition is asymmetrical and unfinished-feeling, with weight pushed toward the upper right and a long calm pull toward the lower left. There are no objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers or text, only color, gesture, density, layering, rhythm and tension."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
